## Evidence

Attach relevant screenshots, engine errors or a flight trace (T to record/save).
For fixed-wing flight behavior, include a flight log (F10 to start/stop, F11 to
mark the problem) when possible; see docs/FLIGHT-LOGGING.md. Include the build
identity shown in Home so we can distinguish the release from newer source.
For performance problems, include a frame-time report following docs/FIRST-LAUNCH.md.
Review logs for personal paths or information before uploading.
